title: Link Sub-Account Below Minimum Balance Threshold
precondition: MAM group requires min $1,000 balance; investor account has $450.
steps: 1. Attempt to link sub-account to MAM group.
expected_result: Linking rejected with validation error: 'Account balance ($450.00) is below group minimum requirement ($1,000.00)'; account remains unlinked.
actual_result: Sub-account balance baseline frozen; sizing engine validates balance on trade fan-out, dropping orders if balance is insufficient.

evidence.rule: Engine drops order below minimum lot allocation or zero balance
